essence: A single properly performed act can destroy the accumulated burden of thousands of births.
Meat is taught as a threefold substance that brings pleasure to the deity.
All the small kinds of meat are regarded by the wise as the lowest category.
The octad of great meats is taught as a substance that pleases the deity.
Garlic is remembered as a substitute for meat.
